title: Freya and the Vector
author: Ulyana Sterling
blurb: Xanthe Ravensworth, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
